conditions.endpoint: Visible benchmark h1 in preview DOM then 2 requestAnimationFrame callbacks; parent performance.now monotonic clock
conditions.start: After host helper JS is loaded, before mounting Sandpack or creating PreviewRuntime and requesting dependency set; navigation and host JS download excluded equally
conditions.network: Local HTTP services; Sandpack public remote bundler and npm CDN over ordinary internet, no artificial throttling; OS, DNS and remote CDN caches not cleared
conditions.sandpack: New browser context and Network.clearBrowserCache each trial; public React 19.3.0 only, HTML table; bundler server cache cannot be cleared

conditions.toiWarm: Same dependency artifact; POST hit must return 200; new browser context and cleared HTTP cache; fresh Worker/WASM initialization
conditions.toiEdit: Same runtime, retained Worker/esbuild context and browser dependency cache; edit source to committed visible marker; no package lookup
conditions.renderDifference: TOI uses private @toi/tds Table; Sandpack uses equivalent plain HTML table with same 20 masked rows, no private package; not an equal dependency workload
